test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: what is the full form of NASSCOM?

options.text: NATIONAL AFFILIATION OF SOFTWARE AND SERVICES COMPANIES
NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SERVIES AND SOFTWARE AND COMPANIES
NATIONAL AGENCIES OF SERVICES AND SOFTWARE AND COMPANIES
NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SOFTWARE AND SERVICES COMPANIES

solution:
The correct answer is __**NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SOFTWARE AND SERVICES COMPANIES**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SOFTWARE AND SERVICES COMPANIES** (NASSCOM) is a trade association of the Indian Information Technology (IT) and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) industry.
 
• NASSCOM was established in 1988 and is a non-profit organization.
 
• The association is involved in policy advocacy and helps create a conducive business environment for the IT-BPM industry in India.
 
• NASSCOM's membership spans over 2800 companies, including Indian and multinational companies that have a presence in India.
 
• The organization is instrumental in promoting innovation and research in the field of IT and BPO services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NASSCOM organizes various events, conferences, and seminars to foster knowledge sharing and networking among industry professionals.
 
• The association also plays a pivotal role in skill development and talent nurturing in the IT sector through various initiatives and programs.
 
• NASSCOM has been actively involved in policy formulation and representation of the IT sector's interests at various government and international forums.
 
• The association's efforts are aimed at enhancing India's position as a global IT hub and ensuring sustainable growth of the industry.
